notes: GMTK Game Jam 2026 (https://noname90.itch.io/secondsbeforethebreath) by zankorobos13. Complete Unity 2022.3.6f1 submarine-captain simulator with playable Menu, Main, Submarine, Lose, and Win scenes in EditorBuildSettings. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2026 zankorobos13). Official Unity packages only (2D feature 2.0.0, URP 14.0.8, TextMesh Pro 3.0.6, Timeline, uGUI, Visual Scripting, and built-in modules). Liberation Sans (OFL 1.1) is the bundled TMP default font. Submarine.mp3 is theredshore's CC0 Freesound sample rowrow (https://freesound.org/people/theredshore/sounds/83977/). TextMesh Pro EmojiOne sprites/asset and TMP Documentation were omitted; TMP Settings m_defaultSpriteAsset was cleared because it pointed at the omitted EmojiOne asset. No DOTween, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL.
